look for discrete, dense white spots that stand out against the softer gray of the lung parenchyma.", "Classify the finding as consistent with healed varicella zoster virus pneumonia if the pattern shows diffuse, random distribution of calcified micronodules, distinguishing it from tuberculosis or histoplasmosis which typically present with upper-lobe predominance or lymphatic distribution."]}]

B) Pulmonary hematoma and pleural thickening
